Physical Star Palace tax receipt is registered, stocked by the Chaotic Sea island general shop for 5 low-grade metal spirit stones with stock 20, and right-click use records QuestProgress flag star_palace_island_trade_tax_paid in PlayerCultivation NBT; Chaotic Sea island general and Outer Sea public stall prices now apply the 10% Star Palace market tax until that flag is present, while ferry quest effects and reputation consequences remain future work.

Physical Diyuan permit is registered as the access-token carrier, stocked by tianyuan_merit_exchange for 1200 Alliance Merit Tokens, and consumed by worldpack secret-realm entry to diyuan through the existing server-side ticket path; reward sources, realm/monthly purchase gates, and quest checks remain future work.

Physical Wind Feather Raft ticket is registered as the travel-token carrier, stocked by tianyuan_merit_exchange for 300 Alliance Merit Tokens, and consumed by server-side worldpack travel from great_jin_central/dajin to Tianyuan without using the 3x3 Spirit Gathering Array portal. Route NPC presentation and richer travel gates remain future work.

Physical pressure-resist charm is registered as the first Diyuan pressure-environment aid carrier, is stocked by tianyuan_merit_exchange for 200 Alliance Merit Tokens, now has a first shapeless crafting recipe from paper, Diyuan Pressure Moss, Armor Talisman, and mid-grade Metal Spirit Stone, and now right-clicks at Void Refinement or higher to write a half-day pressure-resist timer that mitigates the first Diyuan pressure loop. Dedicated art, exact loot placement, pressure depth tuning, and quest/FTB routing remain future work.

Physical Yin-Body Protection Charm is registered as the first Yinming/Nether River survival aid from consumables_catalog.json#yin_body_protection_charm. Qi Refining or higher players can right-click it to write a half-day Yin-protection timer that softens the existing Yin underworld hazard cadence, duration, divine-consciousness drain, damage, and negative effects. The first shapeless recipe reuses implemented talisman paper, Yin Stone, and Soul Fragment carriers; exact Yin-protect talisman crafting, Yin Luo shop placement, drops, dedicated art, and quest/FTB routing remain future work.

Physical Diyuan Pressure Moss is registered as a rare spiritual-herb material carrier and is now consumed by the shipped pressure_resist_pill alchemy recipe plus the first pressure_resist_charm crafting recipe; actual Diyuan gathering, dedicated art, loot placement, and richer pressure-depth balance remain future work.

Physical Fengyuan Clan Ginseng is registered as a rare spiritual-herb material carrier and is now consumed by the shipped spirit_realm_condense_pill alchemy recipe; actual Spirit Fengyuan gathering, Spirit Fengyuan-specific acquisition, dedicated art, loot/shop placement, NPC placement, and FTB Quests routing remain future work.

Physical Spirit Realm Condense Pill is registered as an epic visible pill carrier, has a shipped data-driven alchemy recipe from 1x Fengyuan Clan Ginseng, has first realm-gated right-click effects, and has first sect-secret formula acquisition through danxia_valley_contribution_hall; Spirit Fengyuan-specific acquisition, dedicated art, loot/shop placement, NPC placement, and FTB Quests routing remain future work.

Physical Pressure-Resist Pill is registered as a rare visible pill carrier, has a shipped data-driven alchemy recipe from 2x Diyuan Pressure Moss, has sect-secret formula acquisition through danxia_valley_contribution_hall, and now uses the CatalogPillItem runtime path for Void Refinement-gated right-click consumption. Its server-side pressure-resist timer mitigates the first Diyuan pressure tick hazard; Diyuan moss gathering, NPC/loot/quest placement, FTB Quests routing, dedicated art, and deeper pressure balance remain future work.
